_comment: Local hub against the Stripe SANDBOX, for exercising checkout with test cards. Expects hub/.env.sandbox (gitignored) to carry an sk_test_ key and GUARDIAN_DATA_DIR=./data-sandbox -- its own database, because the test suite rebuilds ./data every test and would wipe a running hub out from under you. The file is NOT named .env on purpose: pydantic-settings reads env_file='.env' from the process cwd, so a hub/.env is also read by every test run from hub/ -- test_billing_trial_only went red because the sandbox's GUARDIAN_BILLING_MODE=plans leaked into the suite. --env-file is passed explicitly for the same reason in reverse: launched from the repo root, the default lookup finds nothing and the hub boots silently against defaults (trial_only, no Stripe), which looks fine and tests nothing.
